rows8to10.rule: rival-issued, VOIDED by the tick into Wc, 2601 <= Wc <= 2696; order: issuer r01 first, then Wc, then promise number; witness: the first with boundOpenProgress0AtWcMinus1, wcIsEffectiveWeekMinus8, wcAtMost2696 and issuerHasNoProductionAtWcMinus1

row11.rule: rival-issued, open, bound and progress 0 at post-tick w, 2600 <= w <= 2695, beneficiary announced with effectiveWeek - 8 = w + 1, VOIDED or not; order: issuer r01 first, then Wc = w + 1, then promise number; witness: the first with issuerHasNoProductionAtW and passCallsActorAtW
